title: Synthetic Data in AI: Challenges, Applications, and Ethical Implications

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing qualitative case studies of generative AI art filters (e.g., GoArt) disproportionately altering dark skin tones compared to light skin tones, and discussing literature on dataset audits (e.g., the MIT Tiny Images dataset) that reveal racial discrimination.
Analyzing literature and past dataset audits (such as the MIT Tiny Images dataset) to highlight how uncurated internet data and synthetic data generation processes perpetuate gender discrimination.

Evaluating qualitative examples in AI artistic creation to demonstrate how generative models manifest preferences for specific cultural backgrounds or artistic styles based on skewed training dataset compositions.

Conceptual discussion on the lack of demographic diversity in synthetic datasets, noting how underrepresentation of specific age groups leads to imbalanced data distributions and discriminatory model performance.
